{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.32

|game2= arma2oa
|version2= 1.64

|arg= global

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Returns selection damage. Same as [[getHitPointDamage]], only the argument is selection part instead of hit point.
{{Feature|informative|Some part names are in Czech; see the [[ArmA: Armed Assault: Selection Translations|translation table]].}}

|s1= vehicle [[getHit]] selection

|p1= vehicle : [[Object]] - vehicle to be queried

|p2= selection: [[String]] - selection part name

|r1= [[Number]] - before {{GVI|arma3|1.94|size= 0.75}}, [[Nothing]] was returned when an invalid ''selection'' was provided (now returns {{hl|0}})

|x1= <sqf>hint str (player getHit "head");</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>private _engineDamage = _car getHit "motor";</sqf>

|seealso= [[setHit]] [[getHitPointDamage]] [[setHitPointDamage]] [[setDamage]] [[damage]] [[getHitIndex]] [[setHitIndex]]
